definition: Karol Hausman is a professor, researcher and technology executive known for his work on robot learning and artificial intelligence.
details: Led the RT-1, RT-2, and Open X-Embodiment robotics projects at Google before co-founding Physical Intelligence to build generalist robot brains.

explainer.lead: Karol Hausman is a Computer scientist and robotics researcher.

contributions.name: In Scaling Simulation-to-Real Transfer by Learning a Latent Space of Robot Skills, published in The International Journal of Robotics Research (2020), Hausman and collaborators proposed learning a low-dimensional latent space of skills in simulation and adapting them efficiently to physical robots.

timeline.what: He has been serving as an adjunct professor at Stanford University since 2021.
